energy.topic:
base_view: readings
fields:
- readings.reading_id
- readings.meter_id
- readings.recorded_on
- readings.kwh
- readings.zone
- readings.total_kwh
joins: {}
readings.view:
catalog: synthetic-review
dimensions:
  kwh:
    sql: '`kwh`'
  meter_id:
    sql: '`meter_id`'
  reading_id:
    primary_key: true
    sql: '`reading_id`'
  recorded_on:
    sql: '`recorded_on`'
  zone:
    sql: '`zone`'
measures:
  total_kwh:
    aggregate_type: sum
    sql: ${readings.kwh}
schema: dma_energy
table_name: gold_readings
